request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me change or remove those charge lines on an invoice. Update the total when I do.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is complete and verified — the Playwright test passes (`removing a line item lowers the total`), and the full build (Java + frontend) compiled cleanly.

## What I implemented

The change request — *"change or remove those charge lines on an invoice; update the total when I do"* — as a small, additive full-stack change. No schema migration was needed: the existing `line_items` table already supports removal and edits.

**Server (OfficeFloor REST)** — one new YAML + one new logic class per endpoint, following the existing `ToggleTask` mutation pattern:
- `RemoveLineItem` → `POST /api/invoices/{id}/line-items/{lineItemId}/remove` — deletes a line (verifies it belongs to that invoice first).
- `UpdateLineItem` → `POST /api/invoices/{id}/line-items/{lineItemId}/update` — changes description/qty/price, reusing the same validation as line-item creation.

**Front-end** (`features/projects/feature.tsx`, `InvoiceDetail`):
- Each line's description, quantity, and unit price are now editable inputs (keeping their existing `lineitem-description` / `lineitem-qty` / `lineitem-unitprice` test ids), with a `lineitem-save-<id>` button.
- Added a `lineitem-remove-<id>` button per row (the anchor the test drives).
- The `invoice-amount` total re-derives from the remaining/edited lines — live as you type, and after a save or remove reloads from the server.

**Notes:**
- No `data-testid` was renamed or removed; new ones are additive.
- No audit record was added, as the test asserts none for this behaviour.
- Endpoints live under `rest/api/` (so paths start with `/api/`), each in its own file — no central router edited, and no pinned scaffolding touched.
